why: The two frames are almost the same, but 2's light is warmer and softer: the light pools on the back wall read as real downlights, and the stools' shadows on the floor are less hard-edged and less CG-crisp, so the room feels lit by its own fixtures. Image 1's sharper floor shadows, brighter bar-top glare and larger, harsher colour wash on the plaster wall look more like a render than a night photograph.
